name: alle-bd-sec-scan
description: Simple scan to bring scan information into the build pipeline.
author: ProductTech

inputs.name: blackduckconnection
inputs.label: Service connection name for Black Duck

inputs.name: failOnSecurityRisks
inputs.label: Fail on security risks
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail task on CRITICAL or HIGH security risks. Defaults to true.

inputs.name: securityExclusions
inputs.label: List of security component names to exclude from checks
inputs.helpMarkDown: List of security component names to exclude from task checking delineated by comma space (, ).

inputs.name: failOnLicenseRisks
inputs.label: Fail on license risks
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail task on HIGH license risks.

inputs.name: licenseExclusions
inputs.label: List of licenses to exclude from checks
inputs.helpMarkDown: List of licenses to exclude from task checking delineated by comma space (, ).

inputs.name: policyExclusions
inputs.label: List of policy names to exclude from checks
inputs.helpMarkDown: List of policy names to exclude from task checking delineated by comma space (, ).
